At loose radius the factory loses to a shuffle of itself, because a diffuse trajectory passes near everything and a lingering one does not; at tight radius (0.09) it wins by 18 points, so coverage IS measurable. But across three long runs the factory's tight-radius rate is 5.6%, 20.2% and 11.2% against nulls of 3.4%, 2.2% and 2.2% -- consistently separated and varying nearly fourfold. A bound set now would be set on one draw from a wide distribution, which is exactly how m7 and the 0.9 drift threshold were set and had to be withdrawn.
